completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

active_mission.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
active_mission.objective: Use the full eleven-role cloud swarm to prove that the USDT to USDC migration is complete across active bot runtime, Paper runtime, market data, strategy/risk, backtests, reports and UI; reproduce and explain the large historical backtest difference between the original USDT 3x80 path and the later USDC 3x80 path without mixing fresh-start and carried-account assumptions; find concrete code, configuration, data, reporting, UI or runtime defects, route proven defects through repair, and after every repair rerun the complete A01-A11 chain. When the migration is clean, execute a final controlled USDT/USDC comparison and full regression/QA/governance test before completion is claimed. All operational validation remains Paper-only against real public Binance USDC market data with simulated fills.
constraints: Run in GitHub-hosted virtual environments; no owner laptop dependency.
The eleven cloud roles must run without OpenAI/API secrets; their default mode is deterministic verification and supervision.
Trading mode is permanently Paper-only for this project phase: real public Binance market data, simulated orders/fills, persistent Paper account state.
Never send real or testnet exchange orders and never request Binance account credentials.
Do not replace real Binance candles with synthetic market data for operational Paper evaluation; deterministic fixtures remain allowed only for unit/regression tests.
Audit every active-bot occurrence of legacy USDT market symbols; historical evidence and explicit legacy-rejection guards may remain but must never become active runtime configuration.

Reproduce the original USDT reference and later USDT/USDC controls with their exact documented windows and account-state assumptions; never compare a carried account path to a fresh start as if they were equivalent.
Quantify quote/candle effects separately from account-path, high-water, open-position, slot, coin-filter and portfolio-risk effects.
Do not weaken the 5 percent daily loss pause or 20 percent drawdown halt merely to improve historical performance.
Do not relabel a fresh-start result as continuation of the older USDT account path.
Do not activate new strategy or risk parameters without a separate explicit owner activation decision.
Repair only proven implementation/configuration/data/reporting defects; do not tune the strategy merely to force the USDC result toward the historic 733 value.
Keep failed candidates, losing windows and contradictory evidence visible.
After any repair, rerun all eleven roles and the final controlled comparison before completion is claimed.
acceptance: All eleven roles participate in the migration mission and emit fresh evidence for their assigned layer.
All eleven default cloud roles execute without OpenAI or Binance private API credentials.

Active runtime, Paper state, market universe, configuration and UI use the intended USDC quote; remaining USDT references are classified as historical evidence or explicit legacy guards rather than active trading configuration.
The original 3x80 USDT reference remains reproducible at approximately 733.306 ending equity from the documented 2023-09-01 start, with its account path preserved as historical evidence.
The later same-window fresh controls remain separately reproducible and attributed: approximately 201.11 USDT versus approximately 203.62 USDC from the documented 2024-03-24 fresh start.

The explanation for 733 versus about 203 explicitly separates carried-account state from fresh-start state and quantifies the dominant early persistent portfolio-risk halt rather than blaming the quote migration without evidence.
A02 verifies the controlled USDT/USDC comparison and the migration audit artifacts; A08 verifies strategy/risk invariants and early-loss contributors without data leakage.
A03 verifies Paper/shared-portfolio parity for equivalent assumptions and rejects legacy USDT Paper state instead of mutating it.
A04 verifies active UI/report provenance shows the correct quote and contains no stale active USDT market labels.
A05 verifies the persistent Paper ledger is current, intact and USDC-only for active checkpoints/positions.
A06 executes integration/regression checks and routes any proven defect into repair rather than masking it.
A07 verifies all ten real public Binance USDC markets and current candles without private credentials.
A09 performs fresh full Python and UI QA after all repairs and issues QA_PASS.
A10 verifies all specialist evidence, requires repair on any failed migration invariant, and never treats a failed specialist as complete.
A11 audits A01-A10 plus QA evidence and issues GOVERNANCE_PASS only after a clean final rerun.
A final controlled USDT/USDC comparison and full A01-A11 regression/QA/governance test pass after the last code change.
No automatic merge, no real-money order path and no active-strategy activation occurs.
